title: Fleet Tenure Refund Credit — Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
On cancellation of a Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit plan of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans, the fleet tenure refund credit rewards long-standing service accounts. It counts the whole months from the opening date of the customer's service account, as the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records show it, to the effective date of the cancellation, which is the request date.

| Whole months from account opening to effective date | Fleet tenure refund credit (USD) |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 20.00 |
| 24 or more, but fewer than 60 | 10.00 |
| Fewer than 24 | None |

Boundary readings: 60 whole months earns 20.00, and 59 earns 10.00. 24 earns 10.00, and 23 earns none.

Hypothetical dating: an account opened on 8 October reaches 24 whole months on 8 October two years later. On 7 October of that year it has 23.
